items.title: Strong acids aur strong bases ke salts (print mein doosra 9.8.1) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Salts of Strong Acids and Strong Bases, printed as a second 9.8.1 on page 204.

blocks.text: Strong acids aur strong bases se bane salts, jaise sodium chloride, ke liye strong acid ka conjugate base (HCl se Cl-) bohat kamzor hai aur pani se khaas react nahi karta, aur strong base ka conjugate acid (NaOH se Na+) bhi bohat kamzor hai aur pani se khaas react nahi karta. Pani mein NaCl(s) se Na+(aq) + Cl-(aq): Na+ strong base NaOH ka conjugate acid hai aur pH par asar nahi karta; Cl- strong acid HCl ka conjugate base hai aur pH par asar nahi karta. Solution neutral rehta hai.

blocks.prompt: Potassium nitrate ka solution tezabi, basic ya neutral hoga? Wazahat karein.
blocks.explanation: Neutral. K+ strong base KOH ka conjugate acid aur NO3- strong acid HNO3 ka conjugate base hai; dono pani se react karne ke liye bohat kamzor hain, to na H3O+ banta hai na OH-.

items: Strong acid + strong base salt (NaCl): koi ion hydrolyse nahi hota; solution neutral.
